parsed.why: No local facility restriction in force; hate-crime law covers gender identity and two cities protect restroom use. Hostile trajectory via licence-marker ban is mainly resident-facing. Above parent, below protective divisions.

Facility statute in force across government buildings and airports with criminal trespass enforcement; licence markers treated as fraud; no gender-identity hate-crime coverage; advocacy travel advisory. Tier-1 local exposure below parent.

Worst tier: birth-sex facility confinement including airports, criminal penalties plus private bounty lawsuits, active licence invalidation notices with no grace period, added to Do Not Travel. Universal exposure with no remedy.

Only division improving in 2026 assessment: hostile facility, sex-binary, document and care laws repeatedly enjoined under state constitution, none operative. Remaining exposures are national regime plus a religious-refusal law and flag ban.

Most Protective tier: public-accommodations discrimination ban, gender-identity hate-crime coverage, shield law, open M/F/X documents, custody by gender identity. Local protections operate; residual exposure is the shared national border and document regime.
